text: Standing in this modern, clean environment, I am aware of the surrounds—the silent, expectant air of an empty meeting room, the sterile promise of invention in the R+D showcase. My mind drifts between curiosity and anticipation. The glass barrier offers both transparency and separation—what conversations and innovations might unfold here? I feel a gentle excitement; here lies the intersection of ideas and possibility, and I am privileged to be an observer of potential becoming reality.
